Plan your tip around major events like Sails on the Potomac, June 12-14 at the Old Town waterfront or new interactive exhibits opening at George Washington’s Mount Vernon. During your stay, be sure to explore all of the historic sites and unique events that recognize America’s semiquincentennial.
